$comment: Storyboard looks. `prompt` opens every frame's prompt; `plan` tells the shot planner how this look shoots; `preview` is the sample scene drawn for the hover preview (node scripts/assets/looks.mjs).

looks.label: Cinematic
looks.caption: Movie light, real lenses, a graded film look.
looks.prompt: Cinematic film still, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, rich color grade
looks.plan: Shoot it like a feature film: varied shot sizes, motivated camera moves.
looks.preview: A young woman in a yellow raincoat walks through a rainy neon night market carrying a paper bag of oranges, medium shot.

looks.label: Documentary
looks.caption: Handheld, candid, true-to-life.
looks.prompt: Handheld documentary photograph, available light, true-to-life color, candid and slightly imperfect framing
looks.plan: Shoot it like a documentary: handheld, observational, natural moments.
looks.preview: A young woman in a yellow raincoat walks through a rainy neon night market carrying a paper bag of oranges, medium shot.

looks.label: POV
looks.caption: Through the main character's own eyes.
looks.prompt: First-person point-of-view shot through the main character's own eyes: only their hands and forearms are visible at the bottom edge of the frame, natural head-height perspective, slightly wide lens, photorealistic
looks.plan: Every shot is first person, through the main character's eyes: we never see their face, only their hands, arms and what they look at.
looks.preview: First-person view walking through a rainy neon night market, the character's own hands holding a paper bag of oranges at the bottom of the frame, stalls and crowds ahead.

looks.label: Third-person game
looks.caption: Over the shoulder, like playing them in a game.
looks.prompt: Third-person video game screenshot: the camera follows just behind and above the main character's shoulder, the character seen from behind in the lower part of the frame, realistic modern open-world game graphics, no HUD, no interface, no text
looks.plan: Every shot is a third-person game camera: it follows behind the main character's shoulder, as if the viewer is playing them.
looks.preview: Seen from behind and just above her shoulder, a young woman in a yellow raincoat walks through a rainy neon night market carrying a paper bag of oranges.

looks.label: 3D animation
looks.caption: A stylized animated feature.
looks.prompt: Stylized 3D animated feature film still, soft global illumination, expressive characters, rich detailed sets
looks.plan: Shoot it like an animated feature: clear staging, expressive poses.
looks.preview: A young woman in a yellow raincoat walks through a rainy neon night market carrying a paper bag of oranges, medium shot.
